title: DarkPlaces
wikitext:
DarkPlaces is a client originally created to support the mod of the same name. However it is usable as a general [[QuakeWorld]] client. It sports [https://www.icculus.org/twilight/darkplaces/screenshots.html extensive graphical capabilities].
